subject: Amendment Required to Draft Bill of Lading
body:
Dear Partner,

Please review the Shipping Instruction, which serves as the authoritative reference for our shipment.

We found discrepancies in the draft Bill of Lading that must be amended to match the Shipping Instruction.

The Consignee is listed as EAST BRIGHT FZ-LLC in the Shipping Instruction, but appears as UAB NOVAKOPA in the draft Bill of Lading.

Similarly, the Notify Party is listed as EAST BRIGHT FZ-LLC in the Shipping Instruction, but appears as UAB NOVAKOPA in the draft Bill of Lading.

Please update the draft Bill of Lading accordingly at your earliest convenience.

Sincerely,
Shipping Operations
